39567.commentary: (ANa) khīṇ'āsavo catusaccabuddho nāma. kappasatasahass'ādhikāni dve asaṅkhyeyyāni pāramiyo pūretvā sāmaṃ paṭividdhapaccekabodhiñāṇo paccekabuddho nāma. kappasatasahass'ādhikāni cattāri vā aṭṭha vā soḷasa vā asaṅkhyeyyāni pāramiyo pūretvā tiṇṇaṃ mārānaṃ matthakaṃ madditvā paṭividdhasabbaññutaññāṇo sabbaññubuddho nāma.

examples.text: idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, yaṃ nissitā tattha subhaṃ vadānā, paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ puthupaccekasaccāni… sabbāni tāni nuṇṇāni honti panuṇṇāni cattāni vantāni muttāni pahīnāni paṭinissaṭṭhāni.
katame cattāro? tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho thūp'āraho, paccekasambuddho thūp'āraho, tathāgatassa sāvako thūp'āraho, rājā cakkavattī thūp'āraho'ti.

39572.commentary: (DNa) das'ettha issarā āguṃ, paccekavasavattino'ti etasmiñ'ca brahmasahasse ye pāṭiyekkaṃ pāṭiyekkaṃ vasaṃ vattenti, evarūpā dasa issarā mahābrahmāno āgatā.

examples.text: das'ettha issarā āguṃ, paccekavasavattino, tesañ'ca majjhato āga, hārito parivārito.

39573.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of pacceka
39573.construction:
pati > paty > pacc + eka + aṃ
pacceka + aṃ

examples.text: atha kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro… ekam'ekañ'ca bhikkhuṃ paccekaṃ dussayugena acchādesi, āyasmantañ'ca ānandaṃ ticīvarena acchādesi, āyasmato ca ānandassa pañcasatavihāraṃ kārāpesī'ti.
yathā kho pana pacceka'puṭṭhassa veyyākaraṇaṃ hoti, evam'evaṃ evarūpāya parisāya yāvatatiyaṃ anusāvitaṃ hoti.

yassa kassaci, mahānāma, kulaputtassa pañca dhammā saṃvijjanti, yadi vā rañño khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa, yadi vā raṭṭhikassa pettanikassa, yadi vā senāya senāpatikassa, yadi vā gāmagāmaṇikassa, yadi vā pūgagāmaṇikassa, ye vā pana kulesu paccek'ādhipaccaṃ kārenti, vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.

39575.meaning1: comes back (to); returns (to); falls back (on); rebounds (to)
39575.commentary: (NIDD1) na paccetī'ti sotāpattimaggena ye kilesā pahīnā, te kilese na pun'eti na pacceti na paccāgacchati.

examples.text: yo appaduṭṭhassa narassa dussati, suddhassa posassa anaṅgaṇassa, tam'eva bālaṃ pacceti pāpaṃ, sukhumo rajo paṭivātaṃ'va khitto.
na kappayanti na purekkharonti, dhammā'pi tesaṃ na paṭicchitāse, na brāhmaṇo sīlavatena neyyo, pāraṅ'gato na pacceti tādī'ti.
kiṃ nu satto'ti paccesi, māra diṭṭhigataṃ nu te, suddhasaṅkhārapuñjo'yaṃ, na'y'idha satt'upalabbhati.
jānāmi passāmi tath'eva etaṃ, diṭṭhiyā eke paccenti suddhiṃ, addakkhi ce kiñ'hi tumassa tena, atisitvā aññena vadanti suddhiṃ.

39577.synonym: adhigacchati, adhigameti, anupāpuṇāti, appeti, āpajjati, pāpuṇāti, phassayati, phusati, phuseti, phussayati, sampāpuṇāti

examples.text: yesaṃ saddhā ca sīlañ'ca, pasādo dhammadassanaṃ, te ve kālena paccenti, brahmacariy'ogadhaṃ sukhan'ti
te me ijjhiṃsu saṅkappā, yadattho pāvisiṃ kuṭiṃ, vijjāvimuttiṃ paccesaṃ, mān'ānusayam'ujjahan'ti.

39579.meaning2: came on to, realized, fell back

39580.meaning1: having taken over; having spread over

39585.construction: pati > paty > pacc + ava + roha + ana

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana, bho gotama, yānagato samāno patodalaṭṭhiṃ abbhunnāmeyyaṃ, yānā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo paccorohanaṃ dhāretu.

39587.meaning1: having come down; having descended; having dismounted (from)
39587.construction: pati > paty > pacc + ava + roha + itvā
39587.commentary: (DNa) yānā paccorohitvā'ti ayānabhūmiṃ, dvārakoṭṭhakasamīpaṃ gantvā yānato paṭiorohitvā.

examples.text: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattiko'va yena kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā kassapaṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

39594.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of pacchā
39594.meaning1: after; afterwards; later; in the future

examples.text: muñca pure muñca pacchato, majjhe muñca bhavassa pāragū, sabbattha vimuttamānaso, na punaṃ jātijaraṃ upehisi.

39595.grammar: ind, prep, abl sg of pacchā

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭikkamati, piṭṭhito rathaṃ pavatteti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo assadoso.
purato pacchato vā'pi, aparo ce na vijjati, atīva phāsu bhavati, ekassa vasato vane.

39596.meaningLit: rule about (teaching the Dhamma to someone while) walking behind

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, puriso ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno addhānamaggappaṭipanno. tassa purato'pi'ssa dūre gāmo pacchato'pi'ssa dūre gāmo.
sudhotarajapacchadaṃ subhaṃ, goṇakatūlikasanthataṃ navaṃ, abhiruha sayanaṃ mah'ārahaṃ, candanamaṇḍita-sāragandhikaṃ.
